messages.author: 0c722f02bfd81abd
messages.subject: new ggts package
parts:
Hey ggplot2 group,

My work usually involves plotting time economic and financial time series and shading recessions or bear markets.  I've automated the process into a couple of functions that constitute a new package, "ggts".  I use this package often with my own work, but I'm not sure what the demand will be like from the R community.

If anyone is interested, they can install the package from my github page:

https://github.com/ChandlerLutz/ggts

I'd be interested in hearing any feedback (be gentle; it's my first attempt at an R package)

-Chandler
